subject: cabin baggage
statement: Each passenger may carry one cabin bag weighing up to 7 kg on all Charminar Airways flights.

subject: cabin baggage
statement: A cabin bag must not exceed 55 cm x 35 cm x 25 cm including wheels and handles, and it must fit in the overhead bin.

subject: personal item
statement: In addition to the cabin bag, each passenger may carry one personal item such as a handbag, laptop bag or small backpack weighing up to 3 kg, which must fit under the seat in front.

subject: checked baggage domestic Saver fare
statement: Domestic Saver fares include a free checked baggage allowance of 15 kg per passenger.

subject: checked baggage domestic Flex fare
statement: Domestic Flex fares include a free checked baggage allowance of 20 kg per passenger.

subject: checked baggage international economy
statement: International economy fares include a free checked baggage allowance of 30 kg per passenger.

subject: excess baggage domestic
statement: Excess baggage on domestic flights is charged at ₹650 per kg at the airport.

subject: excess baggage international
statement: Excess baggage on international flights is charged at ₹1,500 per kg at the airport.

subject: checked baggage
statement: No single piece of checked baggage may weigh more than 32 kg.

subject: sports equipment domestic
statement: Sports equipment such as golf bags or bicycles on domestic flights carries a handling fee of ₹2,500 per item.

subject: prepaid excess baggage domestic 5 kg
statement: Prepaid excess baggage of 5 kg on domestic flights costs ₹2,750 when bought on the website, app or call centre at least 24 hours before departure; after that only the airport rate applies.

subject: oversized cabin bag at gate
statement: Cabin bags that are too large or too heavy at the gate are moved to the hold, and excess baggage charges may apply.

subject: checked baggage allowance
statement: The checked baggage allowance may be split across several pieces, as long as no single piece weighs more than 32 kg.

subject: items over 32 kg
statement: The 32 kg limit per piece cannot be waived, even on payment; heavier items must be sent as cargo.

subject: excess baggage at the airport
statement: Excess baggage charges at the airport counter can be paid by card or UPI.

subject: date change domestic
statement: Changing the date or time of a domestic booking costs ₹3,000 per passenger per sector, plus any fare difference.

subject: date change international
statement: Changing the date or time of an international booking costs ₹4,500 per passenger per sector, plus any fare difference.

subject: fare difference
statement: When a booking is changed, the passenger pays the change fee plus the difference between the old fare and the new fare if the new fare is higher; lower fares are not refunded.

subject: name correction
statement: Correcting a misspelt passenger name costs ₹1,000 per passenger; the passenger cannot be changed to a different person.

subject: standard seat selection domestic
statement: Standard seat selection on domestic flights starts at ₹250 per seat per sector.

subject: extra legroom seat domestic
statement: Extra legroom seats on domestic flights cost ₹1,200 per seat per sector.

subject: online convenience fee
statement: Bookings made on the website or app carry a convenience fee of ₹350 per passenger per sector.

subject: airport counter booking
statement: Tickets bought at an airport ticket counter carry a service fee of ₹500 per passenger.

subject: same-day earlier flight change
statement: Moving to an earlier Charminar Airways flight on the same day costs ₹2,000 per passenger, subject to seat availability, and is only available at the airport counter, not online.

subject: booking changes
statement: Date and time changes can be made on the website, app or through the call centre.

subject: refund processing card and UPI
statement: Refunds to cards and UPI are processed within 7 working days of the cancellation.

subject: refund method
statement: Refunds are always returned to the original form of payment; cash refunds are not given for online bookings.

subject: credit shell
statement: A credit shell issued instead of a refund is valid for 12 months from the date of issue.

subject: no-show refund
statement: If a passenger does not show up for a flight, only statutory taxes and airport charges are refunded; the base fare is not refundable.

subject: no-show tax refund
statement: Refunds of taxes on no-show tickets must be requested within 90 days of the scheduled travel date.

subject: airline-cancelled flight
statement: If Charminar Airways cancels a flight, the passenger may choose a 100% refund of the total amount paid, including the convenience fee, or a free change to another flight.

subject: travel agent bookings
statement: Refunds for tickets bought through a travel agent are processed only through that agent.

subject: long delay
statement: If a flight is delayed by more than 6 hours, the passenger may cancel and receive a full refund.

subject: credit shell
statement: A credit shell can be used in part, and the remaining balance stays valid until the same expiry date.

subject: shorter delays
statement: If a flight is delayed by 6 hours or less and the passenger cancels, the normal cancellation fee applies.

subject: domestic cancellation more than 72 hours before departure
statement: Cancelling a domestic booking more than 72 hours before departure costs ₹3,500 per passenger per sector.

subject: domestic cancellation within 72 hours of departure
statement: Cancelling a domestic booking within 72 hours of departure costs ₹4,250 per passenger per sector.

subject: domestic cancellation cutoff
statement: Domestic bookings can be cancelled up to 2 hours before departure; after that the ticket is treated as a no-show.

subject: international cancellation
statement: Cancelling an international booking costs ₹6,000 per passenger per sector.

subject: cancellation fee cap
statement: The cancellation fee never exceeds the base fare plus fuel surcharge of the ticket.

subject: free look-in period
statement: Within 48 hours of booking (the free look-in period), a domestic ticket can be cancelled or changed free of charge if departure is at least 7 days away.

subject: airline cancellation compensation
statement: If Charminar Airways cancels a flight with less than 24 hours' notice, passengers receive compensation of up to ₹10,000 in addition to a full refund.

subject: airline cancellation compensation
statement: Compensation for airline cancellations is not paid when the cancellation is caused by weather or other events beyond the airline's control.

subject: after free look-in period
statement: After the 48-hour free look-in period, or for flights less than 7 days away, the normal cancellation and change fees apply.

subject: web check-in
statement: Web check-in opens 48 hours before departure.

subject: web check-in
statement: Web check-in closes 60 minutes before departure.

subject: airport check-in domestic
statement: Airport check-in counters close 45 minutes before departure for domestic flights.

subject: airport check-in international
statement: Airport check-in counters close 75 minutes before departure for international flights.

subject: boarding gate
statement: Boarding gates close 25 minutes before departure.

subject: recommended airport arrival domestic
statement: Passengers on domestic flights should arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure.

subject: identity documents domestic
value: Aadhaar, passport, voter ID, driving licence, PAN card
statement: Domestic passengers must show a valid government photo ID at the airport entrance and at check-in: Aadhaar, passport, voter ID, driving licence or PAN card. DigiLocker copies are accepted.

subject: web check-in
statement: Web check-in can be done on the website or app, and the boarding pass can be downloaded or shown on a phone.

subject: seat assignment at check-in
statement: Seats not chosen before check-in are assigned free of charge.

subject: late at boarding gate
statement: Passengers who are not at the boarding gate when it closes lose their seat and are treated as no-shows.

subject: identity documents international
statement: International passengers need a valid passport and any visa required for their destination.

subject: Charminar Miles earn rate
statement: Charminar Miles members earn 5 Miles for every ₹100 of base fare.

subject: Silver tier
statement: Silver tier requires 15,000 Tier Miles earned within 12 months.

subject: Gold tier
statement: Gold tier requires 40,000 Tier Miles earned within 12 months.

subject: Charminar Miles
statement: Charminar Miles expire 36 months after the month in which they were earned.

subject: Miles redemption
statement: The minimum redemption is 1,000 Charminar Miles.

subject: Gold tier
statement: Gold members receive an extra 10 kg of checked baggage allowance on every flight, plus priority check-in and boarding.

subject: Silver tier
statement: Silver members earn 25% bonus Miles on every eligible flight.

subject: Charminar Miles earning
statement: Only the base fare earns Charminar Miles; taxes and fees do not.

subject: Charminar Miles crediting
statement: Charminar Miles are credited within 7 days of travel.

subject: Miles redemption
statement: Charminar Miles can be redeemed for flights, seats and excess baggage.

subject: Blue tier
statement: Every member starts at Blue tier on joining Charminar Miles.

subject: wheelchair assistance
statement: Wheelchair assistance is provided free of charge.

subject: wheelchair assistance
statement: Wheelchair assistance should be requested at least 48 hours before departure.

subject: unaccompanied minor service
statement: The unaccompanied minor service costs ₹5,000 per child per sector.

subject: unaccompanied minor service
statement: The unaccompanied minor service is mandatory for children aged 5 to 11 travelling alone.

subject: pregnancy
statement: Pregnant passengers need a fitness-to-fly certificate from a doctor from the 28th week of pregnancy.

subject: pregnancy
statement: Pregnant passengers are not accepted for travel beyond the 36th week of a single pregnancy.

subject: mobility aids
statement: Wheelchairs and other mobility aids are carried free of charge in addition to the normal baggage allowance.

subject: unaccompanied minor service
statement: An unaccompanied minor is escorted by a staff member from check-in until handed over to the named adult at arrival, who must show photo ID.

subject: wheelchair assistance
statement: Wheelchair assistance can be requested through the website, app or call centre.

subject: pets in cabin
statement: Pets are allowed in the cabin on domestic flights only.

subject: pets in cabin
statement: A pet travelling in the cabin must weigh no more than 7 kg including its carrier, and the carrier must fit under the seat in front.

subject: pets in cabin
statement: Carrying a pet in the cabin costs ₹4,500 per pet per sector.

subject: pets in hold
statement: Pets travelling in the hold are charged ₹1,000 per kg of the combined weight of pet and crate.

subject: pets in cabin
statement: A maximum of 2 pets are accepted in the cabin on any one flight, on a first-come basis.

subject: snub-nosed breeds
statement: Snub-nosed dog and cat breeds such as pugs, bulldogs and Persian cats are not accepted in the hold.

subject: pet age
statement: Pets must be at least 8 weeks old to travel.

subject: pets in hold
statement: Pets travelling in the hold must be in an IATA-approved crate.

subject: pet travel documents
statement: Pets need a vaccination record and a health certificate issued within 7 days of travel.
